Edit <Picture 1> into a precise four-view orthographic character turnaround sheet of this exact same woman on a flat solid dark slate-grey background (RGB 48,52,59), shortening her sea-teal cloak into ONLY a short mid-back hooded cape ending cleanly at her shoulder blades (no long cloak behind her waist or legs) and adding a straight medieval steel short sword held firmly in her right hand.

A wide horizontal slate sheet contains four equal vertical columns in a single straight row, all four figures standing at the exact same head-to-boot height and scale on the same baseline, with clean empty slate between figures:

1. COLUMN 1 — STRAIGHT FRONT VIEW (facing directly toward the viewer): Her arms hang naturally at her sides in the exact relaxed A-pose of <Picture 1>. Her left hand (viewer's right) is empty. Her right fist (viewer's left) grips the weapon aimed STRAIGHT OUT AT THE CAMERA along the line of sight — seen strictly head-on in extreme end-on perspective so ONLY her wrapped knuckles, the vertical dark iron crossguard, and the tiny foreshortened diamond tip pointing dead-center toward the viewer are visible. Zero sideways or downward-hanging blade length is visible.

2. COLUMN 2 — EXACT RIGHT-SIDE PROFILE (90-degree turn facing page RIGHT, showing her right side closest to the camera): Her right arm hangs vertically straight down at her side, and her closed right fist holds a straight double-edged medieval steel short sword extending HORIZONTALLY STRAIGHT FORWARD TO PAGE RIGHT at a strict 90-degree right angle from her vertical forearm (blade parallel to the floor, pointing horizontally right, vertical crossguard). Shows the full side silhouette of the steel blade, vertical crossguard, leather grip, and round pommel jutting horizontally forward to page right, plus her short mid-back sea-teal hood/capelet, laced olive leather bodice, moss-green loincloth, and tan cuffed boots.

3. COLUMN 3 — EXACT LEFT-SIDE PROFILE (90-degree turn facing page LEFT, showing her left side closest to the camera): Her empty left arm hangs vertically straight down at her left side with her green forearm bracer, relaxed empty left hand, and brown belt pouch at her hip. Her far-side right arm is hidden behind her torso while the front half of the exact same horizontal straight steel short sword blade juts cleanly forward to page LEFT past the front of her thigh (parallel to the floor, pointing horizontally left at the exact same hip height as Column 2). Shows her short mid-back sea-teal hood/capelet, laced olive leather bodice, moss-green loincloth, and tan cuffed boots in exact left profile.

4. COLUMN 4 — STRAIGHT BACK VIEW (180-degree turn facing directly away from the viewer): Her sea-teal pointed hood ends in a short mid-back cape at her shoulder blades over her laced olive-brown leather back corset, narrow moss-green rear loincloth, bare toned legs, and tan cuffed boots. Her left hand (viewer's left) is empty showing the smooth back of her hand. Her right hand (viewer's right) holds the weapon aimed STRAIGHT FORWARD AWAY FROM THE CAMERA — seen strictly from behind so ONLY the smooth back of her fist, the round steel pommel cap facing straight at the viewer, and the top and bottom tips of the vertical crossguard are visible; the blade is completely hidden behind her fist pointing away from the viewer (zero blade or bar sticking out sideways or downward).

Preserve <Picture 1>'s exact warm-umber inked gouache brushwork, crisp detail, vivid local pigments, and neutral even overhead lighting across all four views. Only the four full-length figures on flat slate grey; no text, labels, floor, or shadows.
